Shadow Ball vs Primarina: Gholdengo SpA 203, Life Orb. Shadow Ball 80 BP vs Primarina SpD ~122-184. Neutral (Ghost vs Water/Fairy — neutral). 80*1.3 = 104 BP effective. Damage roughly: 203 Atk vs 150 SpD, ~45-55%. Primarina at 54% — might not KO.

Make It Rain: 120 BP Steel vs Primarina — Steel is neutral vs Water/Fairy? Fairy weak to Steel! Primarina is Water/Fairy, so Steel is super effective (2x). 120 BP * 1.3 Life Orb = huge. Definitely KO on Primarina at 54%.

But Make It Rain lowers SpA by 2 after. Then Rotom at 6% comes in — but we'd be at -2 SpA. Shadow Ball at -2 vs Rotom 6%... Rotom SpD 114-174. Shadow Ball 80 BP at -2 SpA (halved): 203/2 = ~101 effective... with Life Orb 104 BP. vs Rotom SpD ~145. Damage maybe ~35-40%. Rotom at 6% dies easily.

Wait, but does Primarina kill us first? Speed: our 104 vs Primarina 72-123. If Primarina outspeeds and uses Sparkling Aria, we die at 27 HP. Then we lose.

Hmm. If we die, opponent has Primarina 54% + Rotom 6% vs nothing — we lose.

So we need to outspeed or survive. We can't survive any hit at 27 HP.

If Primarina outspeeds, we lose regardless of move choice. If we outspeed, Make It Rain KOs Primarina, then Rotom comes in at 6%, we're at -2 SpA but Shadow Ball still kills 6%.

Actually wait — after Make It Rain, Life Orb takes 19 HP (10% of 194), leaving us at ~8 HP (27-19=8). Then -2 SpA. Rotom comes in. We need Shadow Ball to kill Rotom at 6% (~10 HP). At -2 SpA with Life Orb: base ~101 SpA equivalent... damage vs Rotom SpD 145: roughly 80 BP * 101/145 scaling... Let's estimate: at full SpA 203, Shadow Ball does ~50% to Rotom. At -2 (101 effective), ~25%. Rotom at 6% dies.

But also Rotom could Volt Switch... doesn't matter, it's at 6%.

Actually, could also consider: does opponent switch Rotom in on Make It Rain? Unlikely, Primarina stays.

Alternatively Shadow Ball first on Primarina — if it doesn't KO, Primarina kills us. Make It Rain is the right call for the KO.

Speed uncertainty: if Primarina is faster, we lose either way. So Make It Rain.

Actually, one consideration: could we Recover first? At 27 HP, Recover brings to ~124. But if Primarina outspeeds, we die anyway. If we outspeed... Recover then take a hit and survive, then attack. But that gives Primarina a free hit — Sparkling Aria does ~75%+ (did 75% to Kingambit with higher HP). 124 HP * 0.75... would survive at ~30. Then we'd attack next turn. But that's slower and riskier (could be a crit or Moonblast). Attacking now is better if we outspeed.

Make It Rain.

decisions.thought: Only opposing Life Orb Gholdengo remains at 13%. Aqua Jet deals priority damage; if it survives and attacks, Life Orb recoil should finish it. Rotom remains at 10 HP and has previously outsped Gholdengo, so Volt Switch is the backup finisher.
